Our Gas Cooker Install Services

Gas appliances must be installed correctly to avoid leaks, carbon monoxide risks, and invalid warranties. Our certified engineers ensure your cooker is installed safely, legally, and to the highest standard — protecting your home and your family.


Gas Cooker Installation

Professional installation of your new gas cooker and disconnection of your old gas cooker if required.

Gas Certifiticates

Gas Safe Registered engineers with full insurance and certs provided.

Testing & Checks

Full safety checks and functional testing as well as checks for leaks and pressure.

LPG Conversions

We can convert gas hobs to LPG where required.


Brands

We support the installation of all major and smaller brands of gas cookers.
